facts.text: I am planning to set some career development goals for the next quarter.
I recently had a meeting with my manager to discuss my performance and future opportunities within the company.
My manager is named Rachel.
Rachel mentioned that the company is considering me for a promotion to Senior Marketing Specialist.
I want to focus on developing new skills.
I want to focus on taking on more leadership responsibilities.
I feel that my strengths lie in developing new skills and taking on more leadership responsibilities.
I think developing my project management skills would be beneficial.
I will be leading a team if I get promoted.
I asked for recommendations for online courses or certifications to start with project management.
I think I will start with Coursera's Project Management Specialization.
I have heard great things about Coursera and University of Virginia.
I want to focus on specific areas of project management such as Agile or Scrum.
I will focus on Agile and Scrum as I go through the Coursera specialization.
I want to apply the project management skills I learn to my current role before I get promoted.
I think I will start by creating a project dashboard to track my progress and deadlines.
I have been feeling overwhelmed with multiple projects and tasks.
I want a clear visual representation of my work to help me stay organized and focused.
I would like to volunteer for project leadership on a small project within my team.
I want hands-on experience in project planning and execution by volunteering for project leadership.
